# Lab 7.8: Federated Queries

## What We Are Going to Do
Query a live Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL database from BigQuery with `EXTERNAL_QUERY`, and join it with BigQuery data.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create a small PostgreSQL instance.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud sql instances create lab-pg --database-version=POSTGRES_16 --tier=db-f1-micro \
  --region=us-central1 --root-password='ChangeMe#123'
gcloud sql databases create crm --instance=lab-pg
gcloud sql connect lab-pg --user=postgres --database=crm &lt;&lt;'EOF'
CREATE TABLE vip_customers (user_id INT PRIMARY KEY, tier TEXT);
INSERT INTO vip_customers VALUES (1, 'gold'), (2, 'silver'), (3, 'gold');
EOF</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Create a Cloud SQL connection.** **+ Add data → Connections to external data sources**:
   - **Type**: Cloud SQL – PostgreSQL
   - **Connection ID**: `lab_pg`, **Location**: US
   - **Instance ID**: `PROJECT:us-central1:lab-pg`, database `crm`, user `postgres`

   Then grant the connection's service account **Cloud SQL Client**:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SA=$(bq show --format=json --connection $PROJECT_ID.us.lab_pg | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['cloudSql']['serviceAccountId'])")
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID --member=serviceAccount:$SA --role=roles/cloudsql.client --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Run a federated query.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT * FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.lab_pg', 'SELECT user_id, tier FROM vip_customers;');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Join live CRM data with BigQuery data.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT v.tier, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders
FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.lab_pg', 'SELECT user_id, tier FROM vip_customers;') v
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` o ON o.user_id = v.user_id
GROUP BY v.tier;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The inner SQL runs in PostgreSQL. Keep it small and filtered.

5. **[CLI] Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq rm --connection $PROJECT_ID.us.lab_pg
gcloud sql instances delete lab-pg --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `EXTERNAL_QUERY` | Runs SQL inside Cloud SQL, returns rows |
| Freshness | Always live data |
| Performance | Slower than native tables |
| Also supported | AlloyDB and Spanner |
